stem.text: Four properties of beryllium, Be, or a beryllium compound are listed.
Which property is different from the property of magnesium or the equivalent magnesium compound?

A.text: Be reacts with $\text{O}_2$ when heated in air; Mg does not.

B.text: Be reacts with aqueous $\text{H}_2\text{SO}_4$ to form a metal sulfate and $\text{H}_2$; Mg does not.

C.text: $\text{Be(NO}_3)_2$ decomposes on heating to form a metal oxide, $\text{NO}_2$ and $\text{O}_2$; $\text{Mg(NO}_3)_2$ does not.

D.text: $\text{BeCl}_2$ reacts with water to form fumes of $\text{HCl}$; $\text{MgCl}_2$ does not.
